scripts.sidecar: cp ../electron-app/renderer/date-range.js ui/ && bun build --compile sidecar/cli.js --outfile src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-$(rustc -vV | awk '/host/{print $2}')
scripts.sidecar:universal: cp ../electron-app/renderer/date-range.js ui/ && for a in arm64:aarch64 x64-baseline:x86_64; do bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-${a%%:*} sidecar/cli.js --outfile src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-${a##*:}-apple-darwin || exit 1; done && lipo -create -output src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-universal-apple-darwin src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-aarch64-apple-darwin src-tauri/binaries/garmin-core-x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.release: bun run sidecar:universal && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --config '{"build":{"beforeBuildCommand":""}}'
